lines.en: I push forward on my pectoral fins.
A line of small pits trails in the mud.
I weave around mangrove roots.
Where water is shallow, I just crawl.
A hop, a slide, another hop.

lines.zh: 尾巴一甩，泥点子飞起来。
lines.en: A tail flick sends mud flecks flying.
I walk along the waterline, cool there.
On dry ground my fins are crutches.
This mudflat is my road.
Tide rising; I move up the bank.
My hops are low but steady.

lines.zh: 前面是水洼，我直接跳进去。
lines.en: A pool ahead; I dive straight in.

lines.zh: 鳍一撑一收，泥就陷下去。
lines.en: My fins push and pull, and the mud sinks under me.

lines.zh: 我沿着滩涂的湿痕往前挪。
lines.en: I shuffle forward along the wet trail on the flats.
You heard that? No. Nothing.
I step soft. You hear nothing.
The hallway is long. Good.
My steps lag behind my shadow.
Propped on fins, one more step.

lines.zh: 我用鳍在泥上走，比你稳。
lines.en: I walk on fins through mud better than you.
The tide is going out, and I follow it.

lines.zh: 泥面上一层水光，我踩着走。
lines.en: A film of water shines on the mud as I walk.

lines.zh: 红树的根缝里，有东西在爬。
lines.en: Something is crawling between the mangrove roots.
My shadow arrives first.
I lie in the mud, eyes only.

lines.zh: 两只眼睛各看各的方向。
lines.en: My two eyes look separate ways.
I wait for a small crab to crawl by.
My fins prop me like four sticks.

lines.zh: 泥里冒泡，是螃蟹在喘气。
lines.en: Bubbles in the mud mean a crab breathes.
I open my mouth and let water cross my gills.
The sun hardens the mud.
I sweep a small hollow with my tail.
The mangrove's shadow shifts over me.

lines.zh: 有只鹭在远处站着，我装死。
lines.en: A heron stands far off; I play dead.
The mud is sticky; I lift myself.
I gulp air in and out.

lines.zh: 水边有虫子，我盯了很久。
lines.en: An insect by the water; I stare long.

lines.zh: 这片滩上，我最小，也最滑。
lines.en: Here I am smallest and slipperiest.

lines.zh: 泥球吐出去，你脚就慢了。
lines.en: One mud ball and your feet slow.
On my fins, I wait in the mud.
On the mudflat, I prop myself on my fins.
I forget my own name.

lines.zh: 那张脸和泥里的倒影重合。
lines.en: That face matches the reflection in the mud.

lines.zh: 我趴在泥里，只露出眼睛。
lines.en: I lie in the mud with only my eyes showing.
I think I forgot how to get ashore.
I reached one thousand.
Time moves slowly here.
The shadow hums softly.
The silence is just right.

lines.zh: 泥慢慢从我的鳍上干掉。
lines.en: Mud dries slowly on my fins.
I do not blink.
I wait. I always wait.

lines.zh: 你的靴子踩坏我的泥坑了。
lines.en: Your boots crushed my mud pits.
Crouching down to catch me?
My eyes roll over your face.

lines.zh: 那面网的眼太密，我钻不过。
lines.en: That net's mesh is too fine for me to slip.
Look down; I am crouched in the mud pit.
You smell of lobster tails.

lines.zh: 我歪头，是在算你离我多远。
lines.en: I tilt my head to judge your distance.

lines.zh: 你笑什么，鱼上岸很奇怪？
lines.en: What is funny about a fish ashore?
You reach out; I hop away first.

lines.zh: 你的影子把泥滩盖住了。
lines.en: Your shadow covers the mudflat.
I watch your fingers; they move.

lines.zh: 你站着不动，我就敢靠近。
lines.en: Stand still and I dare come closer.
Your splashing is far too loud.
I know you; you have fed me.

lines.zh: 你抬起手，我先看你的手指。
lines.en: You raise your hand, and I watch your fingers first.
You near the mud pit, and the mud moves first.

lines.zh: 你的靴子陷住了，先别动。
lines.en: Your boots are stuck; hold still for now.
Mud ball's ready in my mouth.
I see you, Mudskipper.
A mud ball in my mouth, aimed

lines.zh: 你的脚印我都踩过一遍。
lines.en: I have stepped in every print you left.
Up close, you are shorter than the stories say.

lines.zh: 我们就这样对着，谁先眨眼。
lines.en: We face each other, waiting to see who blinks.
On the mudflat, I blink at you.
Salt water, sweat, and another mudflat.

lines.zh: 我正对着你的侧脸，看清了。
lines.en: I have your profile in view now.

lines.zh: 你手里的灯，照出一圈泥。
lines.en: Your lamp lights a ring of mud.
The mud ball I spit won't drop.

lines.zh: 我的泥球不打重力，只打你。
lines.en: My mud ball ignores gravity, not you.

lines.zh: 我把泥球在嘴里转了半圈。
lines.en: I roll the mud ball half a turn in my mouth.
I remember you. Truly.

lines.zh: 你踩着自己的影子，我就在那。
lines.en: You stand on your own shadow, and I am in it.

lines.zh: 你在泥滩上找路，我替你选好了。
lines.en: You search the flats for a path; I have already chosen one.
Back up on this mudflat again.
You are that sound.
The light wavers in your shaking hand.
A piece of my fin is torn.
Do not step; my bones are thin.

lines.zh: 这一下，我半个身子进泥了。
lines.en: That buried half of me in mud.

lines.zh: 我喘不上气，嘴张得很大。
lines.en: I cannot breathe; my mouth gapes.
Blood mixes into the mud, unseen.
I jump into water; the wound stings.
You missed and grazed my tail.
I play dead; stop hitting.

lines.zh: 这一下让我歪了半边身。
lines.en: That left me tilted to one side.
I can still hop; do not count me out.
whisper, it stings.

lines.zh: 我在泥里滚了一圈，又爬起来。
lines.en: I roll once in the mud and rise again.
My mud-caked skin is broken open.

lines.zh: 泥糊的皮裂了，血还是热的。
lines.en: My mud-caked hide splits, and the blood is still warm.
I crawl over mud on my pectoral fins.
Do it again.
This is pain, and I will remember it.
You dare touch me.

lines.zh: 胸鳍折了一边，我歪着撑。
lines.en: One pectoral fin is bent, so I prop myself up crookedly.

lines.zh: 我吐的泥球，专门打慢你。
lines.en: My mud ball is made to slow you down.
Lobster tail: drop it on the mud.
Not in the water; I cannot see it.

lines.zh: 我闻到腥味了，就在你手上。
lines.en: I smell it, right on your hand.
Lower your hand and I will hop over.
One of these lasts me half a day.

lines.zh: 我咬住就不松口，你小心。
lines.en: I bite and hold; be careful.
One more, and I will follow you.
Wiggle it so it moves.

lines.zh: 我吞得下比嘴大的东西。
lines.en: I can swallow things bigger than my mouth.
Done eating, I wipe my mouth with a fin.
Two crawls in the mud and my fins dry out.
Put it down.
That little sound is lovely.

lines.zh: 泥滩上，我用鳍撑着走路。
lines.en: On the mudflat I walk on my fins.

lines.zh: 名字我早忘了，虫子还有吗。
lines.en: I forgot my name long ago; is there more of that bug?

lines.zh: 你摊开手掌，泥腥味盖过甜味。
lines.en: You open your palm; the smell of mud overpowers the sweetness.
The shadow—this looks like mine.

lines.zh: 你把虫子举高，我的鳍先动了。
lines.en: You raise the bug, and my fin moves first.

lines.zh: 你把东西搁在树根上，退开。
lines.en: Set it on the mangrove root and step back.

lines.zh: 我的胸鳍抬起来，又停在半空。
lines.en: My pectoral fin rises, then stops in midair.

lines.zh: 你踩到我的尾巴了，松开。
lines.en: You stepped on my tail; release it.

lines.zh: 我滑了一下，撞在你鞋上。
lines.en: I slip and bump your shoe.
The mud is slick; I cannot stop.
One touch and I bounce away.
My fin brushes your ankle.
Do not press me into the mud.

lines.zh: 你脚下一滑，我顺势滚进泥。
lines.en: Your foot slips; I roll into the mud.
You bend too low; you block the way.

lines.zh: 撞得我满嘴是泥，吐不干净。
lines.en: That filled my mouth with mud I cannot spit.
I pass by your foot; stay still.

lines.zh: 泥球含在嘴里，一喷就到。
lines.en: The mud ball sits in my mouth, ready to spit.

lines.zh: 我这一撞很轻，你倒退了。
lines.en: My bump was light, and you stepped back.

lines.zh: 你的鞋尖陷进我的泥里。
lines.en: Your toe sinks into my mud.
The mud ball is already in my mouth.
Once is enough.

lines.zh: 对不起，我的泥球没收住。
lines.en: Sorry, I could not call the mud ball back.
I am harder than I look.

lines.zh: 我用胸鳍撑起来，跟你平视。
lines.en: I prop myself on my fins and meet your eyes.
We collided. How awkward.
You touched me.
We raise our fins and circle.

lines.zh: 你的鳍比我高，我让一步。
lines.en: Your fin stands taller; I yield a step.
Three turns; whoever stops first loses.

lines.zh: 泥地上画个圈，就是场地。
lines.en: A circle in the mud is our arena.

lines.zh: 我们谁都不咬谁，只用鳍。
lines.en: We never bite, only show fins.

lines.zh: 你的颜色比我艳，我认输。
lines.en: Yours is brighter; I concede.
There is room in my burrow; come.
I dug the burrow mouth a little deeper.
When the tide comes, we part.

lines.zh: 明年这片泥滩，还是我们。
lines.en: Next year this mudflat is still ours.
I will not let you go.
Do not agree too quickly.

lines.zh: 我趴在泥上，用鳍撑着走。
lines.en: I lie on the mud and walk on my fins.
We can share one name.

lines.zh: 潮水会盖过我们的动静。
lines.en: The tide will cover any sound we make.

lines.zh: 我胸鳍撑着泥，抬头看你。
lines.en: Propped on my fins, I look up at you.

lines.zh: 滩涂上就我们两个，挺好。
lines.en: Just the two of us on the mudflat, good.
On the mudflat, we keep watch side by side.

lines.zh: 两只弹涂鱼在泥上并排撑着。
lines.en: Two mudskippers prop themselves side by side.
Even you come in pairs.
I pick up this shell in my mouth.

lines.zh: 掉在泥里的东西，我刨出来。
lines.en: I dig out what fell in the mud.
I hide this shiny bit in my burrow.
I bite down and drag it back.

lines.zh: 泥里有东西硌脚，我捡开。
lines.en: Something sharp in the mud; I move it.
Smaller than rice; I pinch it with a fin.
I stuff the food into my cheek.
I carry the thread you dropped.
This weighs more than I do.
I drag it to the water to rinse.
Small. It fits my hand.
This shadow is almost mine.
Done. Let us go.
Do not watch me pick things up.

lines.zh: 我用胸鳍撑起身子，看看。
lines.en: I prop myself up on my fins and look.
There is another one over there.
You dropped this, right?
I counted. Seven of them.

lines.zh: 我收进口袋——我没有口袋
lines.en: I will pocket it... I have no pockets.

lines.zh: 这枚小螺壳，正好塞住洞口。
lines.en: This little shell will do nicely to plug my burrow.

lines.zh: 那只螃蟹钳子举起来了。
lines.en: That crab raised its claws.
Someone is closing on my owner.
I puff my cheeks, ready to spit.
It stepped onto my ground.
This mud channel is my border.
Raised fins are my last warning.
Its feet are big; the mud will give.
First I circle to its flank.
When my owner steps back, I go.
It cannot smell me; I hug the mud.
The heron's beak is long; keep clear.
I aim for its ankle.
The mud ball is already in my mouth.
If it does not retreat, I will not hold back.

lines.zh: 我记住你踩过的那块泥。
lines.en: I have noted the patch of mud you stepped on.

lines.zh: 水洼里映出你走近的影子。
lines.en: Your approach shows in the puddle's reflection.
A heartbeat. This way.

lines.zh: 我吐一颗泥球，你躲不掉。
lines.en: I spit a mud ball. You cannot dodge it.
The mud ball is already in my mouth.
The mud ball is already in my mouth.
That scent on you.

lines.zh: 你的呼吸乱了，就站在那边。
lines.en: Your breathing is uneven, right over there.

lines.zh: 泥球准备好了，两秒就够。
lines.en: The mud ball is ready; two seconds will do.
You stepped into my mudflat.

lines.zh: 我把泥球顶到舌头下面。
lines.en: I tuck the mud ball under my tongue.

lines.zh: 泥球不含重力，照样砸中。
lines.en: My mud ball ignores gravity, and still hits.

lines.zh: 红树的阴影里，我看见你了。
lines.en: I see you in the mangrove shade.
I caught the scent.

lines.zh: 泥上的脚印和记忆里的一样。
lines.en: These prints match the ones I remember.

lines.zh: 在红树林的泥地上走，比游还稳。
lines.en: On mangrove mud I walk steadier than I swim.
I strafe low along the mud.

lines.zh: 它的影子往哪，我就躲哪。
lines.en: Where its shadow goes, I hide.
Step, pause, watch its response.
The muddy water hides me well.
It turns; I slip sideways.

lines.zh: 我绕到它背后，鳍不沾水。
lines.en: I circle behind, fins out of water.

lines.zh: 它低头找我，我就在脚边。
lines.en: It looks down; I am at its feet.
Two steps away; close enough to spit.
I crouch and slip along the roots.

lines.zh: 它踩出响声，暴露了位置。
lines.en: Its steps betray its position.

lines.zh: 我从水洼这边跳到那边。
lines.en: I hop from pool to pool.
It looks back; I freeze.
Bubbles in the mud give me away.
Just waiting for it to turn its back.

lines.zh: 它把网放下，我就贴身挪过去。
lines.en: It lowers the net, so I creep in close.
Mud ball in my mouth, aimed.
I know the mangrove mud here.

lines.zh: 你的脚已经陷到脚踝了。
lines.en: Your feet are already ankle-deep.
Mud ahead — and a dead end.

lines.zh: 灯亮着，我不用闻也知道。
lines.en: The lamp is lit; I do not need to sniff.

lines.zh: 我用胸鳍在泥地上撑起身子。
lines.en: I prop myself up on the mud with my fins.

lines.zh: 你往泥深处跑，那里没路。
lines.en: You run deeper into the mud, where there is no path.

lines.zh: 你的靴子一声声从泥里拔出来。
lines.en: Your boots pull out of the mud with a smack, again and again.

lines.zh: 我比你慢，可我走的是直线。
lines.en: I am slower, but I travel in a straight line.
There is not a breath of wind on these flats.

lines.zh: 我沿着泥沟绕到你前面。
lines.en: I follow the mud channel around ahead of you.

lines.zh: 你越喘，我越知道你在哪。
lines.en: The harder you breathe, the better I know where you are.
Do not run so fast.

lines.zh: 泥球黏在那家伙身上了。
lines.en: My mud ball stuck to that one.

lines.zh: 我在泥滩上跳，比在水里快。
lines.en: On the mudflat I hop faster than I swim.
You lost a shoe.
The mud ball rolls rounder in my mouth.

lines.zh: 红树后面藏不住你的灯。
lines.en: The mangroves cannot hide your lamp.
A mud ball splats its face.

lines.zh: 它脚步变慢了，泥起作用了。
lines.en: Its steps slow; the mud works.
I bite its toe and hold.
I hop sideways; it misses.
Another spit to seal its eyes.
It swings; I burrow into the mud.
I surface on the other side.

lines.zh: 牙齿扣进它脚踝的软处。
lines.en: My teeth sink into the soft of its ankle.
The mud weighs its legs down.

lines.zh: 我边退边吐，不让它近身。
lines.en: I retreat spitting, keeping distance.

lines.zh: 它踩塌了我的洞，我急了。
lines.en: It crushed my burrow; now I am angry.

lines.zh: 我撞它的脚背，没什么用。
lines.en: I ram its instep; not much use.
It slows; I circle and bite.
Done, I return to my burrow to breathe.
One mud ball, right on target.

lines.zh: 我吐完就往后跳开一步。
lines.en: I spit and hop back a step.
This mud will slow you down.
Do not scream. Others will come.
I will not stop.
One, two — the mud ball's away

lines.zh: 泥球正中你的胸口，闷响。
lines.en: The mud ball hits your chest with a wet thud.
Specks of mud splash across your face.

lines.zh: 泥球出去了，落在你膝盖上。
lines.en: The mud ball is out and lands on your knee.

lines.zh: 我用胸鳍撑起身体，够了。
lines.en: I prop myself up on my fins; that is enough.
This mud ball is headed for your face.
Sorry. It is instinct.

lines.zh: 第二颗泥球已经含在嘴里。
lines.en: A second mud ball is already in my mouth.
My fins prop me up on the mud.
Mud sticks to your legs and slows you down.
You lift your leg the way I do.
I wriggle out of a clutch of eggs.
The pool is only a hand wide.

lines.zh: 我第一次用鳍撑起身体。
lines.en: First time I prop myself on fins.
The mangrove roots tower over me.
I try to hop and tumble over.
Mud plasters my eyes shut.
I shake my head to fling it off.

lines.zh: 一只小螃蟹在旁边看我。
lines.en: A tiny crab watches me.
I open my mouth and drink.

lines.zh: 潮水还没退，我不敢远走。
lines.en: The tide is in; I dare not wander.
The water here is salty.
I find a shallow pit and settle.
Mother roots for food in the mud.
I must learn to find food myself.

lines.zh: 红树根下多了一个小水泡。
lines.en: A small bubble appears under the mangrove roots.

lines.zh: 我第一天只会原地打转。
lines.en: On my first day I could only turn in circles.
The lights are on. A shame.

lines.zh: 我吐一颗泥球，打得很准。
lines.en: I spit a mud ball, and it flies true.

lines.zh: 退潮后的泥滩，和上次一样。
lines.en: The flats after low tide, just like last time.
The tide has just gone out and the mud still crackles.

lines.zh: 我趴在泥滩上，慢慢等潮。
lines.en: Flat on the mudflat, I wait for the tide.

lines.zh: 我撑着鳍，先看清这片滩。
lines.en: I prop myself up and survey the flats first.
I crawl out from under the mangrove roots.

lines.zh: 潮水退了，又是这片滩涂。
lines.en: The tide is out; this mudflat again.
I crouch in the mud and look up at you.

lines.zh: 泥滩上我爬出来，先撑住身子。
lines.en: On the mudflat I pull myself up first.

lines.zh: 滩涂上空空的，只有一个影子。
lines.en: The flats are empty but for one shadow.
At low tide, I climb the mudflat.

lines.zh: 泥里的气泡一个个破了。
lines.en: Bubbles in the mud pop one by one.
My name? Forgotten.

lines.zh: 泥球吐出去，慢慢黏住你。
lines.en: My mud ball slows you down.

lines.zh: 我把身体埋进泥，只留背鳍。
lines.en: I bury myself, leaving only my dorsal fin out.

lines.zh: 从泥里爬上滩，用鳍撑着走。
lines.en: Up from the mud, I prop on my fins.
On the mudflat, I have just crawled out.

lines.zh: 热浪一过，我身上的水就没了。
lines.en: One wave of heat and my skin dries out.
Hot. No fire.

lines.zh: 我摔在硬泥上，弹了两下。
lines.en: I hit hard mud and bounce twice.
Out of water too long, my gills dry.

lines.zh: 我在水里也能活，就是憋得慌。
lines.en: I live in water too, but I gasp.
I cannot swim.
The blast buries me in mud.
Half of me scattered.

lines.zh: 箭插在我的鳍上，甩不掉。
lines.en: An arrow pins my fin; I cannot shake it.
An arrow. I saw it.
Violet light stiffens my fins.
The spell freezes my fins stiff.

lines.zh: 饿久了，我的肚子瘪下去。
lines.en: Starving, my belly hollows out.
My stomach growls.

lines.zh: 雷落在水洼里，我全身抽。
lines.en: Lightning hits the pool; I convulse.
I am still crackling.

lines.zh: 没有泥也没有水，我只能张嘴。
lines.en: No mud, no water; I can only gape.
I am falling.
